Product source commit c68a53af and tree 50e12ecc... are unchanged; the extension was not rebuilt.

DEFECT-07 RESOLVED in c796cd88 and re-verified in this round: the focus guard used to compare import.meta.url (already resolved to /private/tmp/...) with path.resolve(process.argv[1]) (the /tmp/... spelling), so invoking it through a /tmp symlink silently did nothing and still exited 0 - a wrapper could believe a safety gate had run. The fix resolves both sides with fs.realpath. Evidence: artifacts/rules/guard-entry-alias-probe.json runs the old cf541253 guard and the new c796cd88 guard through the same /tmp ancestor-symlink path (old: empty stdout, exit 0; new: {"ok":true,...}, exit 0), artifacts/rules/guard-entry-selfcheck.txt records the upstream regression, and artifacts/focus/focus-preflight.json is a real guard run through that alias path against the live temporary instance, which now executes and writes its guard-violation verdict with exit 1 instead of exiting silently.

DEFECT-01 RESOLVED upstream in a8728f79 and still fixed at cf541253: the older validator demanded a zh-CN member in the generated-locales manifest that the frozen source commit can never emit (RegisteredUiLanguage excludes zh-CN). The current validator requires only the five languages the userscript generator really writes and validates inlineChineseSources instead. No case is blocked for locale reasons.

DEFECT-06 (blocking for every browser case, new in cf541253): browser-focus-guard.mjs requires the owned temporary window to lie entirely outside every active display. On a single-display macOS host this is unreachable, because the WindowServer clamps normal windows so that part of the window always remains on screen. This was measured two independent ways on an owned temporary instance (CDP Browser.setWindowBounds and the Accessibility API) and both agree; see artifacts/focus/window-placement-probe.json and artifacts/focus/focus-preflight.json. The gate therefore turns into a hard stop for all 22 cases, and resume.md forbids browser operations without a running guard.

DEFECT-02 (blocking for 5 cases): the trusted focus-safe helper focus-safe-browser.cjs required by --focus-safe-helper exists neither in the repository nor anywhere under $HOME, and the handoff forbids fabricating it. UI-01, PRIVATE-01, PRIVATE-02, YT-01 and OCR-UI-01 depend on it.
DEFECT-03 (blocking for 5 cases): Playwright is absent from package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml, so --playwright-root cannot be satisfied from this checkout.

DEFECT-04: Chromium 151 ignores --load-extension, which the repository browser specials still pass; the unpacked build had to be loaded through CDP Extensions.loadUnpacked in the earlier part of this acceptance.

DEFECT-05 RESOLVED for the stdio path in this run: the BrowserOS neo control surface is no longer bound to the single daily profile. browseros-claw-server 0.0.66 accepts --config and --stdio, honours a run-local ports.cdp and directories.resources, keeps its state in BROWSERCLAW_DIR, and answered initialize/tools/list with the full 22-tool surface while the daily instance stayed untouched. The handoff still forbids pointing the HTTP path at the daily client configuration, and no browser operation was performed through the control surface because the focus guard never reached running.

The extended window-placement probe and the single focus preflight were run before any browser case, purely to decide whether the mandatory guard can ever certify this host. They are diagnostics, not case evidence, and they never activated, minimized, fullscreened or moved the browser onto another Space.
